title: BigScoots Review 2026: Plans, Pricing, Speed Data, Uptime SLA and Black Friday
excerpt: BigScoots starts at $35 a month, with free migration and a 45-day refund. Here is how 5,779 live sites performed, what the uptime promise really says, and who it suits.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: BigScoots Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Data, Uptime SLA
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: BigScoots review for 2026: managed WordPress prices, speed data from 5,779 live sites, the 99.9% versus 99.99% uptime promise, the 45-day refund, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: BigScoots is managed WordPress hosting from $35 a month. A crawl of 5,779 live sites found a 153 ms median time to first byte, and 82% pass Core Web Vitals. It runs no Black Friday sale.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is BigScoots good? | Yes for professional WordPress sites. A crawl of 5,779 BigScoots sites found a 153 ms median time to first byte, fourth of 13 managed hosts.
How much does BigScoots cost? | Essential 75 is $35 a month, or $350 a year. Core 1000 is $350 a month.
Does BigScoots have a Black Friday sale? | No. BigScoots says on its own blog that it runs no Black Friday or Cyber Monday sales.
Does BigScoots offer a money-back guarantee? | Yes. BigScoots' own pricing page says its pricing is backed by a 45-day money-back guarantee.
Does BigScoots migrate sites for free? | Yes. It lists free, zero-downtime migrations by its own team.
What is the BigScoots uptime guarantee? | 99.99% on marketing pages and 99.9% in the formal agreement, according to CompareBestAI.
How fast is BigScoots? | 82% of WordPress sites on BigScoots pass Core Web Vitals, against a typical 59%, according to TheWeb.Report.
Does BigScoots have 24/7 support? | Yes. It lists 24/7/365 human support with an average reply of about 90 seconds, which is its own claim.
Does BigScoots include backups and staging? | Yes. Daily backups are kept for 30 days, and staging is included.
Does BigScoots have data centers outside the US? | No. HostProdigy lists Chicago and Ashburn, Virginia.
Does BigScoots have AI features? | We found none on the pages we read.
Who should avoid BigScoots? | Hobby sites on a tight budget, sites with mostly far-away visitors and people who want AI tools built in.

meta.rl_takeaways:
A crawl of 5,779 live sites found a 153 ms median time to first byte.
82% of WordPress sites on BigScoots pass Core Web Vitals, against a typical 59%.
Essential 75 is $35 a month, with free migration and a 45-day refund listed.
Marketing pages say 99.99% uptime, and the formal agreement says 99.9%.
meta.rl_r_verdict: BigScoots is a strong managed WordPress host for professional sites. A crawl of 5,779 live sites found fast, consistent performance, and human support and free migration are listed. Check the 99.9% formal SLA, and expect no sale.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You run a professional WordPress site and want human support.
You want free migration and a 45-day money-back window.
You want steady performance over the lowest price.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You run a hobby site on a tight budget.
Most of your visitors are far from the US.
You want AI tools built in.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Fast, consistent live sites in a 5,779-site crawl.
Free, zero-downtime migrations.
Daily backups kept 30 days, staging and a CDN included.
A 45-day money-back guarantee listed.
Clear tiers, with annual billing that saves two months.
meta.rl_r_cons:
From $35 a month, dearer than shared hosting.
No lab test of a plan with a full method.
Formal SLA is 99.9%, below the 99.99% marketing claim.
Few data centers.
No sale and no AI tools.
meta.rl_r_best: Professional WordPress sites that want human support

Pricing and terms | BigScoots' WordPress pricing page and its blog on Black Friday, read on 15 November 2026, plus CompareBestAI's September 2026 reading of the plans

Competitor reviews | The top-ranking BigScoots reviews read, and their findings compared
Our calculations | The price per 1,000 visits table is our own arithmetic from BigScoots' monthly prices
When sources disagree | We show both numbers. For prices we use BigScoots' own page

What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test, and we found no recent lab test with a full method
